description: Config-driven ADK-style workflow for lab reports, after-visit summaries, medication documents, care gaps, PHI review, and human approval.

subagents.name: Healthcare Document Intake Agent
subagents.input_summary: Classify clinical/admin document type and extract patient encounter context.

subagents.name: Clinical Summary Agent
subagents.input_summary: Summarize reason for visit, findings, assessment, plan, follow-ups, and citations.

subagents.name: Lab Result Agent
subagents.input_summary: Extract lab tests, values, units, reference ranges, abnormal flags, dates, and citations.

subagents.name: Medication Review Agent
subagents.input_summary: Extract medications, dosage, route, frequency, start/stop dates, and review flags.

subagents.name: Care Gap and Follow-Up Agent
subagents.input_summary: Extract follow-ups, pending tests, referrals, screenings, care gaps, and patient instructions.

subagents.name: Risk and Safety Flag Agent
subagents.input_summary: Flag abnormal labs, urgent language, medication conflicts, missing follow-up, and human review needs.

subagents.name: PHI and Governance Agent
subagents.input_summary: Identify PHI/PII, redaction needs, audit requirements, approval gates, and governance notes.
